author: fishmaker
quote:
This is a review as a viewer.

It being only 30 FPS at launch is unacceptable and streamers found a way to play it on 60 FPS and the console didn't break so I do not know why rockstar did not release it on 60 FPS.

And there is no online it will release but I think next year so it will take some time.

The game looks like RDR2 but instead of it being in the 19th century it is in a modern city, GTA6 has the same hand fighting style as RDR2 and the gunplay got reworked a little bit but it is still very similar to Red Dead they also added the dead eye slow motion mechanic in GTA.

So in my opinion if you want to play GTA6 but don't want to pay 80 bucks you could get yourself RDR2 for 15 bucks on sale or play GTA6.
